Title: Company branding feature is now available on your organization's Azure AD sign-in page

Body.Content:
The enhanced company branding feature is now generally available on your organization’s Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) sign-in page. Use this feature to add hyperlinks and simple formatting such as bolding, underlining, and italics.

Supported syntax

Hyperlink: [text](link)

Bold: **text** or __text__

Italics: *text* or _text_

Underline: ++text++

Learn more about the enhanced feature.
